cases.rationale: Propose inclusion for this exact whole water-quality/certification/discharge/State-federal permitting and related implementation regime, including the full added judicial, mitigation, recharge/pilot and conditional IBWC mechanisms. Candidate eligibility is not established by a single favorable clause or a universal environmental-law rule. Whole-version evidence is reconciled; binding approval remains separate.
cases.strongest_counterevidence: Broad environmental regulation, judicial access and agricultural exceptions beyond public infrastructure; some provisions are encouragement/sense of Congress, and IBWC authority is conditional rather than actual funding/construction. No single environmental, reporting or permit clause automatically establishes whole-case eligibility.

cases.rationale: Propose inclusion for this exact change to access to review of the environmental authorization process governing projects, preserving its narrow direct-harm target and conditions. No general judicial-procedure or environmental-subject inclusion rule is established.
cases.strongest_counterevidence: This is a limitation on litigant access in a proposed environmental review statute, not construction or technology deployment; whole-parent infrastructure associations alone are insufficient.

cases.rationale: Propose inclusion for the exact jurisdiction and causation condition on effects considered in project environmental authorization review, independently grounded in the amendment’s own mechanism rather than the parent title.
cases.strongest_counterevidence: General environmental-review scope rather than a funded infrastructure project; effects outside one agency’s jurisdiction may still satisfy the cooperating-agency alternative.

cases.rationale: Propose inclusion for the paired statutory threshold defining when project environmental review requires an impact statement, with the own-action harm test and both amendments kept together.
cases.strongest_counterevidence: A general environmental-review threshold rather than construction, procurement or a particular technology; no actual project impact or categorical exemption is established.

cases.rationale: Propose inclusion for this exact whole legal regime governing environmental review and authorizations for projects, with applicant/agency/court procedures, retained safeguards, Tribal qualifications and the material ongoing-corrections exemption included. No general environmental-law or procedural inclusion rule is adopted; binding review remains separate.
cases.strongest_counterevidence: Broad cross-sector environmental/administrative and judicial law, not a funded project or universal permit approval; section4 exempts specified corrective-action cases and substantial qualifications remain.
